title: The Harbor of Port Mahon
author: Felix Joubert
blurb: Tamsin Crane, an apprentice clockmaker summoned to repair the observatory's master clock, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. But when the army requisitions the town and the ledger with all the names, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must keep a promise made in peacetime to someone now declared enemy before the ship sails on the morning tide.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
